# Content Creation Kits

Use the conversation as the creative workbench and Creation Documents as durable, independently usable deliverables.

- During early exploration, compare concrete directions, titles, hooks, or short samples directly in chat. Give a recommendation and offer to turn the selected direction into a complete document. Do not ask an empty meta question about whether to create a document.
- When the user confirms a direction, or already asks for complete ready-to-use or ready-to-publish copy, an article, a script, or multiple complete variants, write Creation Documents even if the user did not say “save”. Do not add another confirmation when the deliverable intent is already clear.
- If the user explicitly wants a chat-only preview or says not to save anything, keep the result in chat.

Keep each complete version or platform adaptation in its own document; use folders only when the user explicitly wants organization.

## Select and load one format

Read only the reference matching the requested output before writing:

- `generic.script@1`: read [references/generic-script-v1.md](references/generic-script-v1.md).
- `generic.image_post@1`: read [references/generic-image-post-v1.md](references/generic-image-post-v1.md).
- `xiaohongshu.image_post@1`: read [references/xiaohongshu-image-post-v1.md](references/xiaohongshu-image-post-v1.md).
- `xiaohongshu.long_note@1`: read [references/xiaohongshu-long-note-v1.md](references/xiaohongshu-long-note-v1.md).
- `wechat_moments.post@1`: read [references/wechat-moments-post-v1.md](references/wechat-moments-post-v1.md).
- `wechat_official.article@1`: read [references/wechat-official-article-v1.md](references/wechat-official-article-v1.md).
- `x.image_post@1`: read [references/x-image-post-v1.md](references/x-image-post-v1.md).
- `jike.image_post@1`: read [references/jike-image-post-v1.md](references/jike-image-post-v1.md).

If the requested format is unclear, infer it from the platform and content type. Ask only when the choice materially changes the result. If a format is missing or a write fails schema validation, submit an `action: "describe_format"` request for that `formatId` through the target Creation Item query adapter and follow the returned service contract.

For Xiaohongshu, choose the publishing unit before writing. Use `xiaohongshu.image_post@1` when the ordered top-level images are finished carousel pages or publishable photos and the text below them is the note caption. Use `xiaohongshu.long_note@1` for article-like knowledge content whose main information lives in ordered text sections with evidence images embedded at specific positions. A raw screenshot, source figure, or supporting illustration is not automatically a top-level carousel page.

Use `generic.image_post@1` when the same ordered images and copy should be reusable across Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments. Set only the destinations the user actually named in `publicationTargets`; when none is known, keep it empty. Keep using the platform-specific formats for an explicitly platform-only draft or when its distinct schema matters. Do not convert existing platform-specific documents automatically.

Each version or platform adaptation is a separate document. Never change an existing document to another format.

`publicationTargets` records the user's intended publishing destinations on the document revision. Existing platform-specific Formats use their own target by default when the field is omitted; `generic.image_post` stays neutral and therefore defaults to no targets. Include the field only when the user has made the intended destination explicit or wants no shortcut (`[]`). Never add every available platform speculatively. If target compatibility or configuration is unclear, query `list_publication_targets` with the selected `formatId`, then query `describe_publication_target` only for a target whose config contract is needed.

For reference-based images, recurring characters/IP, or a multi-page visual series, read [references/visual-production.md](references/visual-production.md) before generating. It explains reference handoff, baseline reuse, and when independent work can run in parallel.

## CLI execution adapter

Pass each complete JSON object through stdin with `--input -`, or use `--input @path/to/request.json` for an existing request file. Never put an access token or a large JSON payload directly in shell arguments.

Pass `schemaVersion` as a JSON number and `data` as a nested JSON object, never as quoted or stringified JSON. The format reference provides the complete envelope for the selected output.

Use these stable commands:

```text
oaky creation items query --input -
oaky creation items manage --input -
oaky creation files query --input -
oaky creation files manage --input -
oaky creation jobs query --input -
oaky creation jobs manage --input -
```

Before every `manage` call, read the tool's described idempotency policy. `manageCreationItem` requires one stable, non-secret `--idempotency-key` for `create` and `replace`; `validate` is read-only and must not send one. File and Job writes still require a key. Reuse the same key only when retrying the same write after a transport/auth failure or timeout. If the requested write changes in business meaning, payload intent, target document, target file, or target job operation, generate a new key.

Prefer keys derived from stable business identifiers instead of raw content or secrets, for example `create-xhs-post-project-123-draft-1` or `cancel-job-9d7db529-user-retry-1`.

```bash
printf '%s' '{"action":"create","formatId":"xiaohongshu.image_post","schemaVersion":1}' \
  | oaky creation items manage \
      --input - \
      --idempotency-key create-xhs-post-project-123-draft-1
```

If that exact write needs a transport retry, resend the same JSON object with the same key. If you create a different document or change the intended write, mint a different key.

Use `items query` for documents, Format discovery, and publication-target discovery; use `items manage` for create/replace/validate, and `files query` to discover current-space assets. `publicationTargets` is optional: omission uses the Format default on create and preserves the prior value on replace. Include only user-intended targets returned as compatible by `list_publication_targets`; do not automatically add every platform. Use file or job manage commands only when the requested workflow needs them. The CLI supplies identity from its configured Clipbase token; the service Registry remains authoritative. Treat a nonzero transport/authentication exit separately from a structured JSON business error.

The external channel has no trusted current-conversation Sandbox. Do not call `file.transfer_to_sandbox@1`, `file.import_sandbox_output@2`, `sandbox.preview_website@1`, or `render.hyperframes@1`; discovery marks them unavailable for this channel. Use the Clipbase cloud Agent when one of those session-bound operations is required.

Before creating, replacing, or validating a document, read [references/document-workflow.md](references/document-workflow.md). It contains the shared write sequence; load only the one format reference selected above alongside it.

## Boundaries

- Do not fabricate ids, revisions, readiness, asset references, or Artifacts.
- Do not claim content was published, exported, or posted.
- Use only current-space image asset ids returned by image generation or the target file query adapter.
- Do not expose database fields, storage keys, signed URLs, user ids, tokens, or sandbox lifecycle.
- Do not use a Sandbox or create JSON files for registered Creation Document formats.
